subject: valkey-cli: remove RESP version assertion from getDatabases() (#2068)
reason: The change only deletes a defensive assertion in valkey-cli's getDatabases() that required the CONFIG GET reply type to match config.current_resp3. That tracked value can only disagree with the server's actual reply type through the cliSwitchProto() desync (implicit --json RESP3 request plus a HELLO 3 error), which requires an old/pre-HELLO-3 or HELLO-disabled server. Both builds under test (the change and its parent) are modern and never error on HELLO 3 (HELLO is CMD_NO_AUTH, uncancellable by ACL, with no config to reject RESP3), and the valkey.action.tools private server has a fixed harness
